facts.fact: The Registrar General's Department says that after the implementation of MAUPASS, the national digital identity platform for individuals, it will extend MAUPASS to give corporate entities a secure identifier for its online systems.

MUS.note: Nothing about a link between civil register and ID system.
A National Digital Strategy is named only in passing, with nothing on its standing or text.

facts.fact: The Registrar General's Department says user acceptance testing is under way for an extended online search of the RGD Land Registry with e-vouchers for online payment, to be rolled out to the public once finalised.

systems.system: RGD online search module and e-vouchers

MUS.note: Nothing about government payments to people.
No enrolment count or share is given.
Nothing about an ID number at birth.
Nothing about who operates or owns the ID system.
No register is said to be keyed on the national ID number.
MAUPASS is named but nothing on issuing unique identities, biometrics or certification.

facts.fact: The Registrar General's Department describes the Mauritius e-Registry System (MeRS) as a mission-critical platform that underpins land and property registration.

MUS.note: Online search of the land registry is only in user acceptance testing, so not online.
The DR site is scheduled for installation in September 2025 and no place is named.
Nothing about mobile money or retail payments.

facts.fact: The Registrar General's Department says e-vouchers for secure online payment of its fees are being introduced and are in user acceptance testing.
